settings.title: Settings
settings.lockedDesc: Only the owner or an administrator can add veterinarians. Ask them to add you under Settings → Team.
settings.leadAdmin: Clinic details, how to add veterinarians to the team, and the appointment portal.
settings.portalDesc: Share this link so owners can request appointments without signing in.
settings.teamDesc: This is how you add people to your GUIAA practice. They do not need to sign up alone first: you invite them and they finish registration with the link.
settings.teamStep1: Reception: schedule, owners, and patients (no CDS consults). Admin: practice and team settings. Veterinarian: CDS consults and records. Reception and admin need no license; veterinarians do—with their own license, not yours.
settings.teamStep2: Type your colleague’s email below and click Send invite. If they already have a GUIAA account, they join your team right away. If not, we email a link (also copied to your clipboard in case the email is delayed).
settings.teamStep3: They open the link, create a password, and accept. Reception/admin: short form. Veterinarian: license and document. Then ask them to sign out and back in: they will see this practice.
settings.teamOneOrg: Important: one account belongs to one practice. If your colleague already opened GUIAA alone, we move them into your clinic (with owners and patients if any). If they already belong to another multi-person team, they must leave that organization first.
settings.teamHowToAria: Steps to invite someone to the team

settings.lastInviteBody: Share it with {{email}} if the email does not arrive (check spam). Shown only this once.

welcome.title: Welcome to GUIAA
welcome.body: Your veterinary practice with clinical decision support (CDS). This quick tour shows you the essentials in one minute.

diagnosis.title: GUIAA Diagnosis
diagnosis.body: Start clinical consultations here: capture signs, chief complaint, and pet details. The CDS workflow structures your clinical reasoning (it does not replace your professional judgment).

patients.title: Owners & Pets
patients.body: Register owners and pets to link clinical history, antecedents, and previous consultations in one place.

agenda.title: Schedule
agenda.body: Organize daily appointments, confirm statuses, and receive online appointment requests from your practice.

inventory-sales.title: Inventory & Sales
inventory-sales.body: Track supplies and medication stock with low-stock alerts. In Sales, issue clinical receipts linked to inventory (no tax invoice).

reports.title: Reports & History
reports.body: View practice KPIs, revenue, and top-selling products. In History, review all your previous CDS consultations.

support.title: Membership, support & shortcuts
support.body: Manage your plan in Membership. Use the support chat (bottom corner) for platform questions. Press Ctrl+K (or ⌘K) to search any module instantly.
